_comment: Kiosk settings (no secrets). Command-line flags override these (py -3.11 app.py --help). mode: hold = no tray: the customer holds the item under the camera 3-5 s (hold_min_s / hold_max_s), the ESP32 turns the chute (OK within ok_timeout_s), the customer lets go and the drop plate's DONE proves it (drop_timeout); esp32 = the tray bin (load cell + YOLO on the tray + ESP32 sorting), sim = the same flow with a simulated ESP32 (labelled SIMULATION, staff key I places an item), camera / attendant = testing without hardware. pretend_weight true = no load cell: the camera starts a deposit and the weight is made up; identify_s = seconds the camera looks at the item before deciding. Missing keys fall back to defaults; the older names 'sorter' and 'serial_baud' are still read.
